//: S01-01A shared compiler options for EVERY tsconfig of this repository. This file deliberately declares NO `lib`, NO `types` and NO `include`: the type ENVIRONMENT of a scope (DOM present or not) is decided by the extending config, never inherited by accident. Scope configs: tsconfig.core.json (framework-neutral, NO DOM) / tsconfig.browser.json (DOM allowed) / tsconfig.server.json (Node runtime, NO DOM) / tsconfig.json (core + node tests) / tsconfig.build.json / tsconfig.test.json.
